description: Defines interfaces and factory functions for Diffie-Hellman key exchange mechanisms, including asynchronous and synchronous variants, within the QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: AsynchronousKeyExchange
classes.description: Interface for an asynchronous Diffie-Hellman key exchange, allowing for private key management and external RPC-based key exchange.

classes.name: SynchronousKeyExchange
classes.description: Interface extending AsynchronousKeyExchange for synchronous key exchange operations, with a final implementation of CalculateSharedKeyAsync.

classes.name: Callback
classes.description: Base class for receiving results of asynchronous key exchange calculations.

methods.name: CalculateSharedKeyAsync
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous calculation of the shared key with a peer public value.

methods.name: CalculateSharedKeySync
methods.description: Performs a synchronous calculation of the shared key with a peer public value.

methods.name: public_value
methods.description: Returns the local public key for key exchange.

methods.name: CreateLocalSynchronousKeyExchange
methods.description: Factory function to create a synchronous key exchange object using a private key or a random generator, based on specified algorithm type.
